why_best: Anchoring the dimensional expansion directly to the viewer's point of engagement maintains seamless cognitive continuity while delivering a refined, high-touch experience.
why_bad: A rigid, center-stage modal pop-up would abruptly sever the browsing momentum and destroy the sense of lightweight discovery.
trap: A near-miss will default to an arbitrary center-origin expansion, instantly breaking the physical illusion that the content is sprouting directly from the target.
